definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 splits 'character' into four senses (4.26 a code value of a coded character set, 4.27 a graphic character in a screen item, 4.28 a COBOL character, 4.29 a single code value in storage); 2023 drops those entries but keeps each sense under its own term (§2023:3.7 alphanumeric character, national character, §2023:3.93 graphic character, §2023:3.37 COBOL character repertoire), so the drop is of a heading, not of a meaning. Character classification classifies code values of the alphanumeric and national coded character sets (4.26/4.29), the 2023 alphanumeric/national characters; no change of scope.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination) are flagged by the word 'initial state' in GR8. GR8 rests only on WHEN a runtime module enters its initial state, and §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 gives the same three activation events word for word as §2023:14.6.2.3.2 (2023 only adds INITIALIZE-clause fill and dynamic tables, 2002 only the communication section initialization, neither touching classification); 14.5.3 and 14.5.10 are not used. Scope unchanged; the reader's cc_locale/pb111 runs at 2002 stand.
